items.title: 葡萄牙｜里斯本—波尔图高铁首段正式开工
items.title_en: Portugal | Porto–Oiã high-speed railway construction begins
items.summary: 葡萄牙Porto–Oiã高铁首段于10月12日开工，全长71公里，包括8公里隧道和19公里桥梁高架，设计时速300公里。
items.summary_en: Construction began on the 71km Porto–Oiã high-speed railway section on 12 October, comprising 8km of tunnels and 19km of bridges and viaducts, designed for 300km/h.
items.why_it_matters: 大型交通基础设施进入施工阶段，具有长期土建及设备供应链价值。
items.why_it_matters_en: A major transport project entering execution offers longer-term civil works and supply-chain potential.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注桥梁钢结构、轨道材料、隧道设备、施工机械和专业分包。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track bridge steel, railway materials, tunnelling equipment, construction machinery and specialist subcontracting.

items.title: 葡萄牙｜约3.6亿欧元铁路信号及通信工程招标
items.title_en: Portugal | €360m railway signalling, telecommunications and ETCS tender
items.summary: Infraestruturas de Portugal发布铁路信号、通信、ETCS设计、施工及维护招标，估算金额3.6亿欧元，截标日为2026年10月14日，编号10020135。
items.summary_en: Infraestruturas de Portugal published a €360m tender for railway signalling, telecommunications and ETCS design, delivery and maintenance, deadline 14 October 2026, reference 10020135.
items.why_it_matters: 明确的公开招标及临近截止时间，适合具有相关资质的专业企业评估。
items.why_it_matters_en: A defined public tender with imminent deadline is relevant to qualified specialist contractors.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注信号系统、光纤、电缆、控制设备和欧洲认证合作伙伴。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track signalling, fibre, cabling, control equipment and qualified European partners.

items.title: 巴林｜Madinat Salman三个社区项目第二期建设进入评标
items.title_en: Bahrain | Madinat Salman Phase 2 community facilities tender in bid review
items.summary: Eskan Bank的Madinat Salman第二期三个社区项目于10月12日开标，收到19份投标，包括市场、超市及体育设施等建筑内容；招标编号EB-2026-E02。
items.summary_en: Eskan Bank opened 19 bids on 12 October for Phase 2 of three Madinat Salman community facilities, including a market, supermarket and sports facility; tender EB-2026-E02.
items.why_it_matters: 已开标进入评估阶段，短期重点在于跟进后续中标承包商和材料采购。
items.why_it_matters_en: The tender has moved to evaluation, so downstream contractor and material-supply follow-up is more relevant than bidding.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注建筑材料、门窗、MEP、装修及分包合作。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track construction materials, doors and windows, MEP, fit-out and subcontractors.

items.title: 巴西｜约1600亿雷亚尔港口与机场基础设施投资计划
items.title_en: Brazil | R$160bn ports, airports and waterways investment pipeline
items.summary: 巴西港口与机场部公布2027—2030年约1600亿雷亚尔投资项目组合，包括34项港口拍卖、70项私人投资授权及机场、水运项目；桑托斯港Tecon 10规划投资约64.5亿雷亚尔。
items.summary_en: Brazil's Ports and Airports Ministry presented a roughly R$160bn 2027–2030 investment pipeline including 34 port auctions, 70 private authorizations and airport/waterway projects; Tecon Santos 10 accounts for an estimated R$6.45bn.
items.why_it_matters: 属于中期投资项目组合，不应理解为所有项目已进入招标。
items.why_it_matters_en: This is a medium-term pipeline rather than confirmation that every package is tendering.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注港机、码头建设、机场设备、工业物流和中国承包商合作。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track port machinery, terminals, airport equipment, industrial logistics and Chinese contractor partnerships.

items.title: 坦桑尼亚｜200米Lwanji I桥梁建设公开招标
items.title_en: Tanzania | 200m Lwanji I bridge construction tender
items.summary: TANROADS发布Mtowisa–Ilemba道路200米Lwanji I桥施工招标，编号AE/001/2026/27/HQ/W/18（TZ-TANROADS-564086-CW-RFB），截止11月2日。
items.summary_en: TANROADS has an open tender for construction of the 200m Lwanji I Bridge along the Mtowisa–Ilemba road, ref AE/001/2026/27/HQ/W/18, deadline 2 November 2026.
items.why_it_matters: 具有具体工程范围和公开截止日期，可评估承包商资格及供应机会。
items.why_it_matters_en: A defined bridge contract and deadline allow focused contractor and supplier evaluation.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注桥梁工程、钢材、混凝土、施工机械和本地联合体。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track bridge works, steel, concrete, construction machinery and local consortia.

items.title: 阿曼｜Thumrait工业城一期基础设施公开招标
items.title_en: Oman | Thumrait Industrial City Phase 1 infrastructure tender
items.summary: 阿曼Madayn为Thumrait工业城一期道路、雨水排水、给排水管网和工业设施建设发出招标，编号4/2026/PEIE/HQ-4，截标日期11月12日。
items.summary_en: Madayn's Thumrait Industrial City Phase 1 tender covers roads, drainage, water and sewer networks and industrial facilities; reference 4/2026/PEIE/HQ-4, closes 12 November 2026.
items.why_it_matters: 工业园区基础设施工程具备较清晰的土建和设备需求；须通过官方平台确认参与资格。
items.why_it_matters_en: Industrial enabling works present tangible civil and utility supply opportunities, subject to official eligibility requirements.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注道路、管网、土建、机电及工程承包合作。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track roads, utilities, civil works, MEP and contracting partners.

items.title: 摩洛哥｜马拉喀什大型体育场周边道路工程咨询招标
items.title_en: Morocco | Marrakech Grand Stadium access roads engineering consultancy tender
items.summary: Marrakech Mobility SA于10月10日发布大型体育场周边及北部城市入口道路改进工程第一期研究和工程管理招标，编号AO.42/MM/2026，估算360万迪拉姆，截止11月2日。
items.summary_en: Marrakech Mobility SA issued a study and project-management tender for Phase 1 of road access works near the Grand Stadium and the city's northern entrance, reference AO.42/MM/2026, estimated MAD3.6m, deadline 2 November 2026.
items.why_it_matters: 当前为工程咨询招标而非道路施工合同，可关注后续土建招标。
items.why_it_matters_en: This is a consultancy tender, not an awarded roadworks package; later civil contracts warrant monitoring.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注工程咨询与本地合作伙伴，并持续跟踪后续道路施工及设备采购。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track consultancy partnerships and future roadworks and equipment packages.
